items.proposition: The garden board describes the seed library as the first practical expression of its neighbourhood-sharing plan.
sourceQuotes: The garden board calls the seed library its first practical expression of the neighbourhood-sharing plan.
This is the board’s stated meaning, not a measured result.
items.materiality: Supports the idea that the library gives the board’s sharing ambition a practical form, while identifying this as an attributed interpretation.
items.boundary: Does not establish that the library increased sharing or produced any other measured result.

items.proposition: The seed library is a pilot, and whether it will be expanded has not been decided.
sourceQuotes: The library is a pilot; expansion is undecided.
items.materiality: Limits conclusions about the initiative’s scale, maturity, and continuation.
items.boundary: Does not establish that the pilot will be expanded, discontinued, or successful.

items.proposition: The source reports no visitor survey or study of sharing outcomes, so it supplies no measured evidence that the library increased neighbourhood sharing.
sourceQuotes: No visitor survey or sharing-outcome study has been conducted.
items.materiality: Directly limits the claim that sharing has already increased and distinguishes the board’s stated meaning from an observed effect.
items.boundary: Does not prove that sharing did not increase; it says the relevant survey and outcome study were not conducted.

items.proposition: The library’s opening hours have not yet been fixed.
sourceQuotes: Opening hours are not yet fixed.
items.materiality: Shows that an operational detail remains unsettled, qualifying how fully the pilot is established in practice.
items.boundary: Does not establish whether the library is open, how often it operates, or what effect the hours have on sharing.

ideaChecks.proposition: “A sharing ambition takes a first practical form”: the board presents the seed library as the first practical expression of its neighbourhood-sharing plan.
“The library has already increased neighbourhood sharing.”

limitations: The source attributes the library’s meaning to the board and explicitly distinguishes that meaning from a measured result.
The source does not report whether sharing increased or decreased; it states that no sharing-outcome study was conducted.
